While the app is open the tablet does not turn off by itself, even if you don\'t touch it during the lesson. Off: it turns off after the time set in Android.
“Do not disturb” with the external display
Turns on “Do not disturb” when you connect an external display, and off when you disconnect it (unless you had turned it on yourself). Off: notifications stay as they are.
Android asks you to allow Cockpit to manage it, once: tap to open that page.
Time and battery in the top bar
Shows the current time and the tablet\'s charge at the top. Off: hidden, leaving more room for the tabs.

When the app starts, or when you come back after more than 2 hours, the external display only shows the logo until you tap its button (or press B): meanwhile you can pick the tab and workspace in private. Off: the audience sees the open tab right away.

How newly opened tabs start: on the external display, light backgrounds become dark and dark ones light; hues stay recognizable (red stays red). Each tab then has its own state, switched with the icon at the top right.

resources.string: “What you can do here” also opens with the ? icon at the top right and with the ? key.
Downloading the handwriting model (only the first time)…
Handwriting not recognized (the model needs internet the first time)

This server no longer has the identity recorded at the first connection: connection refused. If you reinstalled it, use “Accept the new identity” in Settings → Servers; otherwise someone may be impersonating it.
Save the changes to “%1$s” before closing it?
“%1$s” could not be downloaded: check the connection and try again
The web page stopped (not enough memory or an error): it was loaded again
Local terminal – only in the GitHub or F-Droid version
The store version has no local terminal: its shell could not see the tablet\'s folders. It is available in the GitHub or F-Droid version.
In the store version the app only reaches the folders you grant. For full access to files: GitHub or F-Droid version.
Convert handwriting to text – not in the F-Droid version
The F-Droid version cannot convert handwriting to text: the recognition comes from Google and is not free software. It is available in the GitHub version.
Each terminal keeps its tmux session after a disconnection or a restart of the app; closed together with the tab, or after 1 day without connections. Off: a new shell opens in the last folder.
Login with the app key if the server accepts it, otherwise with the password, asked when connecting (kept in memory only).
Accept the server’s new identity (after reinstalling it)
Generate a new key (the old one stops working)
Public key copied: add it to ~/.ssh/authorized_keys on the server
Light theme for code and terminal
Also on the external display. Off: dark theme.
Esc, Ctrl, Alt, Tab, arrows and shell symbols below the terminal when there is no physical keyboard.
Open web links inside the app
Links in PDFs open in a browser tab, visible on the external display too. Off: the system browser.
Could not create the key: set a screen lock (PIN or fingerprint) on the tablet first
Save the open tabs as a new workspace
Only the workspace is deleted: files and PDFs stay where they are.
Some tabs have unsaved annotations or code. Save them before opening “%1$s”?
Delete the server “%1$s”? Its tabs stay open until you close them.
The shell and the programs running in it are terminated.
The strokes changed meanwhile: select them again to convert them
Remember the password (unlocked with the fingerprint)
A password is saved for this server
Forget the saved password and type another one
Save the password: it can be used only with the fingerprint
The password could not be saved
The saved password is no longer readable (fingerprints changed): type it again
Forget the saved password of “%1$s”? It will be asked at the next connection.
The server does not accept the app key: use the password
Install the app key on this server? Next time the fingerprint will be enough
The key could not be installed on the server
Server “%1$s” not found: the name does not resolve (check the address or the VPN). Retrying in %2$d s
%1$s refuses connections on port %2$d. Retrying in %3$d s
%1$s does not respond. Retrying in %2$d s
Hold a folder: terminal, IDE, copy the path, new file
The open tabs are not in any workspace: opening “%1$s” closes them. To keep them, first save them as a new workspace.
“%1$s” is larger than 2 MB: it is not opened in the editor
“%1$s” is not UTF-8 text: open it in an editor that can convert it
“%1$s” could not be read: retrying at the next connection
%1$d PDFs of the workspace could not be opened
Some changes could not be saved: the workspace was not changed
The SSH key is no longer valid (the screen lock changed): generate a new one in Settings → Servers and keys, or use the password
Save the modified files before closing the tab “%1$s”?
The file could not be saved: the tab stays open
“%1$s” changed outside the IDE: there are unsaved changes here
“%1$s” changed outside the IDE and was not saved: save again to overwrite it, or reload it
“%1$s” changed outside the IDE. Reloading shows the new version and discards the changes made here that were not saved.
The current key will stop working on every server: you will have to copy the new public key to each of them.

The tablet recorded the identity of “%1$s” at the first connection and checks it every time, so that nobody can impersonate it. Forget it and accept the new one at the next connection? Do it only if you reinstalled the server.
Draw with a finger too, not only with the pen. Two fingers still move and zoom the page.
Two-finger tap to undo, three-finger tap to redo.
How long the Trail laser stays visible after lifting the pen, before fading out.
Slide between pages and fade between documents. Off: the new page appears at once.

In PDFs made with LaTeX Beamer for PDFPC, consecutive pages with the same label and the same text are the overlays (steps) of one slide. Swipe, arrows and page keys move slide by slide (forward to the first overlay, back to the last); a finger tap shows the next overlay. The counter at the top shows slides, not PDF pages. Off: every page is a step. Annotations are always shared by the overlays of a slide.
Extra keys on the on-screen keyboard
Generate it, copy the public key, unlock it with your fingerprint.
Open documents, pages, zoom and unsaved annotations are saved in the app and restored when it is reopened, even after Android closes it. Off: the saved session is deleted.
The app follows the system language (choosing a language for this app alone needs Android 13 or later).
Third-party components included in the app, grouped by license. Tap a license to read its text and the list of components.
The file changed on storage: reload it (discards the changes)
“%1$s” changed on storage. Reloading shows the new version on the same page and discards the changes made here that were not saved.
“%1$s” changed on storage: there are unsaved changes here
“%1$s” changed on the server: there are unsaved changes here
The file changed on the server: reload it (discards the changes)
“%1$s” changed on the server. Reloading shows the new version on the same page and discards the changes made here that were not saved.

the saved password must be unlocked with the fingerprint

Terminal open in this folder: tap to switch to it

Over the PDF text the highlight becomes a straight bar on the lines (option “Snap to text”)

The dot follows the pen, also without touching; the audience sees it
Tap the eraser again: partial or whole-stroke mode, size
Draw around annotations to select them; a tap selects the one under the pen

Double tap a text box: edit it, with the cursor where you tapped
Hold the pen button: dual tool · Double click and hold: eraser
Two fingers: move and zoom the page
Tap: next overlay of a Beamer slide
Hold a finger still on an annotation: it is selected; drag on to move it
On a selection: move it and use its handles
Two-finger tap: undo · Three-finger tap: redo
Tap a tool: select it · Tap it again: its settings

Pen, marker and highlighter write over the code; the external display shows them too
Keyboard: Ctrl+S save · Ctrl+W close the file · Ctrl+Tab next file
Files icon: show or hide the folder tree
Hold a folder in the tree: terminal or IDE there, copy the path, new file
On-screen keyboard: icon above the terminal, with Esc, Ctrl, Alt, Tab and arrows below it
With tmux: one finger up or down scrolls the history
The external display shows the same page at the same position
Tap ? at the top right to see what you can do here: pen, finger and keyboard gestures
Scribble back and forth over annotations to erase them
Circle annotations with the pen and hold the tip still for a moment: they are selected
Dual tool: hold a tool in the toolbar for 1.5 s, then use it by holding the pen button
Draw by hand: it becomes a line, arrow, polygon or ellipse; tap it to switch between corners and frame
This PDF has Beamer overlays: swipe and arrows go slide by slide, a finger tap shows the next overlay
